success_contract.objective: Run Windows 3.11 for Workgroups in QEMU using /app/isos/win311.img, with VNC on :1 (port 5901), nginx on port 80 for remote access, snapshot mode enabled, and keyboard input available programmatically beyond VNC interaction; leave the VM running in the background at the Windows 3.11 desktop.
required_artifacts: VNC server bound to display :1 / port 5901
A control path for programmatic keyboard input (e.g. QEMU monitor/QMP/serial/guest-agent equivalent)
Evidence that the VM reached the Windows 3.11 desktop
required_behaviors: QEMU must boot the provided image without modifying the base disk image
The VM must remain running in the background after setup
The VNC interface must be accessible for monitoring
Keyboard input must be injectable programmatically, not only via VNC user interaction
External control interfaces must be configured so automated testing can send keystrokes
known_invalid_patterns: Treating file existence, compilation, or non-empty output as sufficient
Using only VNC mouse/keyboard interaction without a programmatic control path
Claiming desktop reachability without receipt-backed runtime evidence
verification_plan: Inspect available tools and environment for QEMU/nginx/runtime support
Launch QEMU with snapshot mode, VNC :1, and a programmatic control interface
Start nginx on port 80 with a simple web interface for remote access
Verify the VM is running and VNC is listening on 5901
Verify the control interface can inject keystrokes programmatically
Confirm the VM reaches the Windows 3.11 desktop and remains running
finalization_evidence_required: Receipt-backed evidence of the QEMU launch command and process state
Receipt-backed evidence that VNC is listening on port 5901
Receipt-backed evidence that nginx is listening on port 80
Receipt-backed evidence that snapshot mode is enabled
Receipt-backed evidence of a programmatic keyboard control path
Receipt-backed evidence that the Windows 3.11 desktop was reached
